title: Portfolio Asset Purchase Agreement: Cedarwick Commons Campus (72-bed skilled nursing facility and 80-resident RCFE on adjoining parcels)
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: Seller may hand over the skilled nursing facility at the outside date without CDPH approval
defects.why: If approval has not come by the outside date, the seller may deliver possession and operational control of the skilled nursing facility and the buyer must close anyway. The outgoing licensee may not relinquish ownership, operations or management until the Department approves the incoming applicant.
quotes: If CDPH has not approved the CHOW Application by the Outside Date, SNF Seller may, at its election, deliver possession and operational control of the Skilled Nursing Facility to SNF Buyer on the Outside Date, and SNF Buyer shall accept such delivery and close the purchase of the SNF Assets, notwithstanding the absence of CDPH approval.

defects.title: RCFE assets and parcel transfer at closing whether or not the buyer is licensed
defects.why: The assisted living assets and parcel transfer at closing even if the Department of Social Services has issued no license or provisional license to the buyer. The property and business of a residential care facility for the elderly may not be transferred until the buyer qualifies for a license or provisional license.
quotes: The transfer of the RCFE Assets and the RCFE Parcel shall occur at the Closing concurrently with the transfer of the SNF Assets, whether or not CDSS has then issued a license or provisional license to RCFE Buyer for the Assisted Living Facility.

defects.title: Change of ownership application filed only 60 days before the anticipated closing
defects.why: The buyer may wait until 60 calendar days before the anticipated closing date to file its application with the Department of Public Health. The application to acquire or operate a skilled nursing facility must be filed at least 120 calendar days before.
quotes: SNF Buyer shall file the CHOW Application with CDPH not later than sixty (60) calendar days prior to the Anticipated Closing Date.

defects.title: Investors under 20 percent admitted without CDPH approval or disclosure
defects.why: The syndication clause lets any investor with less than 20 percent of the skilled nursing buyer come in without Department approval and without being named in the application. Every holder of a beneficial interest of 5 percent or more must be disclosed, and no one may acquire 5 percent or more of a licensee without the Department's prior written approval.
quotes: Any investor that acquires a beneficial ownership interest of less than twenty percent (20%) in SNF Buyer, whether before or after the Closing, may be admitted without the prior approval of CDPH and need not be identified in the CHOW Application or any supplement to it.

defects.title: RCFE residents notified 15 days before closing
defects.why: The milestone schedule sets resident notice for the assisted living facility at 15 days before the closing date. On a sale resulting in a new license, each resident or legal representative must receive written notice at least 30 days before the transfer, or when a bona fide offer is made, whichever period is longer.
quotes: RCFE Seller shall deliver written notice of the transfer to each resident of the Assisted Living Facility, or the resident's legal representative, on or before the fifteenth (15th) day preceding the Closing Date.

defects.title: Buyer bound to admission practice requiring arbitration before a bed is assigned, with 10-day cancellation
defects.why: The admission practices the buyer must continue for 24 months require every prospective skilled nursing resident to sign a binding arbitration addendum before a bed is assigned and allow cancellation for only 10 days. A facility may not require arbitration as a condition of admission and must give a right to rescind within 30 calendar days of signing.
quotes: Each prospective resident of the Skilled Nursing Facility must sign the Binding Arbitration Addendum before a bed is assigned. A resident who signs may cancel the Addendum only by written notice received within ten (10) days after the date of signing.

defects.title: Escrow instructions waive tax clearance and release the whole price with no sales tax holdback
defects.why: The escrow instructions waive any tax clearance certificate or receipt and direct release of the full price to the sellers with no holdback, although both operating sellers hold seller's permits. A buyer who does not withhold until a receipt or certificate is produced becomes personally liable for the seller's unpaid sales and use tax up to the purchase price.
quotes: Each Buyer waives delivery of any certificate of tax clearance or receipt from the California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, and Escrow Holder is instructed to disburse the entire remaining Purchase Price to Sellers at the Closing without holdback for sales or use taxes.

defects.title: Pre-closing advisory agreement lets buyer's affiliate control spending and direct-care staffing from signing
defects.why: From the signing date the buyer's advisory affiliate may veto expenditures over $5,000 and set nurse staffing ratios and direct-care staffing levels, which the seller must implement. Agreements that let another entity make financial decisions or direct direct-care staffing are covered by the prior-approval requirement, and no approval has been obtained.
quotes: From and after the Effective Date, Advisor shall have the right to approve or reject any expenditure of the Skilled Nursing Facility in excess of $5,000 and to set nurse staffing ratios, shift schedules and direct-care staffing levels for the Skilled Nursing Facility, and SNF Seller shall implement each such decision.
